visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and round glasses wearing a grey graphic t-shirt stands in a bright indoor room. He holds a white paper and talks to the camera, gesturing with his hands against a background with a white wall and a television. (2) The scene shifts to a kitchen counter where he holds a large yellow bag of Quaker multi-grain rice and a clear plastic microwave rice cooker with an orange lid. He measures out rice into a small cup and pours it into the container. (3) He stands at a silver kitchen sink, rinsing the rice with water from a white mug and then draining the water while holding the lid. (4) He displays a whole raw fish in its plastic packaging before slicing garlic cloves on a wooden cutting board with a large knife. (5) On a sheet of white parchment paper, he prepares the fish by adding the garlic slices, mushrooms, and shredded cabbage. He seasons it with a green shaker bottle before wrapping the paper tightly. (6) Wearing a blue athletic t-shirt and shorts, he is seen outdoors on a patio with wooden slat walls, jogging in place. He appears exhausted, leaning forward with his hands on his knees while sweating. (7) He returns to the kitchen to open the microwave. The rice has cooked into a solid, hard purple disc which he lifts out with chopsticks, looking confused and amused. (8) He unwraps the baked fish, which is steaming and cooked with vegetables. He takes a bite with chopsticks and looks very pleased. (9) He takes the bowl of failed hard rice outdoors to a farm area and feeds it to two brown chickens who peck at it. (10) He prepares a second meal by slicing several small cucumbers into strips and placing them in a plastic container with soy sauce, garlic, and vinegar. (11) He slices raw chicken thigh meat on a board and mixes it in a bowl with yogurt and seasonings using his bare hand. (12) He fries the chicken pieces in a pan until golden brown and sprinkles them with white sesame seeds. (13) He presents a plate with the chicken and cucumbers. He takes a chilled, frosted glass from the freezer and pours a green can of beer into it. (14) He sits and eats the meal with chopsticks, taking large sips of the beer and expressing extreme satisfaction through facial expressions. The video ends with a cartoon animation of two figures.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator appearing throughout the cooking and exercise scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young male with black hair, wearing round eyeglasses. He wears a grey t-shirt in the morning/afternoon and a blue athletic t-shirt and shorts during exercise and dinner.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a clean, modern white-walled kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a living area with a TV, an outdoor patio with wooden horizontal slats, and a dirt/grass farm area with chickens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male voice narrating over bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop BGM. Transient sound of a paper rustling. (2) Granular thudding sounds of dry rice being poured into a plastic container. (3) Continuous water splashing and pouring sounds followed by a sharp metallic clink against a sink. (4) Rapid, percussive knife thuds against a wooden surface. A high-pitched 'ding' sound effect transitions the scene. (5) Crinkling sounds of parchment paper being folded. A mechanical click of a plastic lid flipping open. (6) Audio track features heavy, rhythmic breathing and panting from the male speaker, indicating high physical exertion. The music volume ducks slightly. (7) A loud mechanical click of a microwave door opening. The voice tone drops in pitch, sounding disappointed. (8) Repeated crinkling sound of opening paper. An elongated vocalization of pleasure ('Mmm'). (9) Distinct clucking and squawking of chickens followed by the sound of rapid pecking against a ceramic surface. (10) Sizzling sound of food hitting hot oil in a pan. Sound of a metal can being opened with a 'pssh-click'. (11) Liquid pouring sound followed by a deep, satisfied sigh. Rhythmic wet chewing sounds as the voice continues in a more relaxed tone. BGM fades out gradually.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Morning Intro -> Lunch Preparation -> Physical Exercise -> Cooking Failure Reveal -> Second Meal Preparation -> Consumption -> Humorous Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents day 5 of a 100-day weight loss journey. It aims to share the creator's low-calorie diet recipes (baked fish and chicken) while maintaining a humorous tone through a failed attempt at cooking multi-grain rice and the reward of a beer at the end of the day. It combines lifestyle vlogging with cooking and light comedy.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features a very high frequency of on-screen text overlays for emotional emphasis, characteristic of East Asian variety-show editing styles. The contrast between the healthy meal prep and the 'reward' beer creates a relatable lifestyle narrative.
